title: Font: Glyph bitmap rendering (codepoint → bitmap buffer)
acceptance_criteria: render_glyph(codepoint, size) returns bitmap buffer with glyph pixels
Bitmap format is 8-bit grayscale (alpha channel for blending)
Glyph dimensions (width, height, x-offset, y-offset) returned with bitmap
Bitmap rendering handles multi-byte UTF-8 codepoints
Rendering performance: < 1ms per glyph at 16px size
Unit test renders known codepoint and verifies bitmap dimensions
Bitmap can be uploaded to sokol_gfx texture for GPU rendering
